title: PPTail ContentItem frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter at the start of a PPTail markdown content item. The markdown body after the closing --- delimiter is the ContentItem.Content value and is not part of this schema. The categories property contains category names; PPTail resolves those names to ContentItem.CategoryIds when it loads the file.

title.description: The title displayed for the content item.

description.description: A short description of the content item.

teaser.description: Optional teaser text for the content item.

ispublished.description: Whether the content item is published.

buildifnotpublished.description: Whether to build the content item even when it is not published.

showinlist.description: Whether to include the content item in content lists.

lastmodificationdate.description: The date and time when the content item was last modified.

slug.description: The URL-friendly identifier for the content item.

tags.description: Tags associated with the content item.

categories.description: Category names. PPTail maps these names to ContentItem.CategoryIds.

menuorder.description: The sort order used when displaying the content item.

byline.description: Optional byline text. PPTail derives one from author when omitted.
